recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless the MPHO profile returns to core; OO Incubator maintainers should preserve the current biologicalSourceEvent.value wording as that profile evolves.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive OO change request for the BiologicallyDerivedProduct Medical Product of Human Origin profile, asking that .biologicalSourceEvent.value identify the donation, collection, or pooling event from which the MPHO item was derived rather than identifying the MPHO item itself.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in core by abdceedb5a8d97f5e86445081845d6ddfa3b4e6d, which changed the MPHO profile source wording from the MPHO-item text to the requested donation/collection/pooling-event wording.
additional_context: The current core checkout still builds BiologicallyDerivedProduct, but it no longer contains or references StructureDefinition/medicalproductofhumanorigin in the BDP core profile pack. Current BDP narrative says the Medical Product of Human Origin profile moved to the OO Incubator IG and remains under development. The current OO Incubator profile source sets biologicalSourceEvent.value to the requested wording, and the base core biologicalSourceEvent comment already explains that a single event identifier can apply to multiple products.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit is appropriate because the target profile is outside current core build scope and the migrated external profile already reflects the requested wording.
